audience: manufacturers who plan production, stock and sales orders in Katana MRP

useCases.title: Check stock levels and negative stock
useCases.text: List the stock levels per variant and location. List variants with negative stock and the date of their latest negative movement.

useCases.title: Trace what changed a stock level
useCases.text: List stock movements to see what changed, when, and which order caused it. List stock adjustments made at a location.

useCases.title: Track manufacturing orders in progress
useCases.text: List manufacturing orders, most recent first. Open one to read its recipe and operation rows.

useCases.title: Create a sales order for a customer
useCases.text: List the customers, then create a sales order for one of them, with the variant and quantity of each row.

useCases.title: Create a manufacturing order
useCases.text: Create a manufacturing order for a producible variant at a location. Katana fills the recipe rows from the product recipe.
